hz_end() IS A GATING WINDOW, NOT AN EXIT-DATE FUNCTION -- NOT A BUG. hz_end('2026-07-20',10) returns 2026-08-04 while direct trading-day count gives 08-03. Its docstring states it extrapolates on a 5-day week past the panel edge and deliberately ROUNDS OUTWARD (hz_end('2026-07-24',10) returns a Saturday). That is correct fail-closed behavior for earnings-gate windows and wrong for precise exit dates. Use direct trading-day counting for horizon expiry. risk-sizer initially mis-framed this as a tooling gap in the stale-fallback family; it is not.
